subject: Fix loop bootstrap race: new session-bound loops swept dead before first spawn
description: Bug in /Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude/orchestrator/daemon.js: sessionIsLive() (~line 310) only counts a session live if it has a running agent or a recently-touched in_progress claim. A loop started via loop_start({session}) has neither until its first spawn, so sweepStaleLoops() (~line 331, invoked at the top of every next_action tick, ~line 586) immediately demotes it with sweptReason "driving session dead" and next_action returns an empty loops array. Reproduced 2026-06-10 (loop 3cdd8fde-4fbf-4735-b893-94c9e70908f5). Fix: give session-bound loops a bootstrap grace window — e.g. skip the session-dead demotion while (now - startedAt) < stale_minutes, or treat a fresh lastProgress as liveness for the session check. Add a regression test in test/ if the suite covers sweepStaleLoops. Work in an isolated worktree branch, do NOT merge to main. Note: if a PreToolUse gate blocks direct edits to orchestrator source, write to /tmp and cp into place.
